description: Our Song is pure sixteen-year-old me, scribbling in the back of a math notebook instead of doing my homework. The 'sneakin' out late, tappin' on your window' line? I still think it's adorable. This one is nostalgic and sweet and I can't help but grin every time it comes on. It's young, but it's honest, and that counts for a lot 🫶✨
